neighbours.label: ' research', ' teaching', ' scholarship' and ' service' when they are listed together as a faculty member's academic duties ('teaching and research', 'research, teaching and service'); 'market research' or 'customer service' stay quiet
fire: Tenure decisions weigh a candidate's teaching, research and service.
The university is known for excellence in teaching and research.
Professors must balance research and teaching with committee work.
The award recognizes faculty scholarship and service to the college.
Her contract divides her time between teaching and research.
The dean praised the department's commitment to teaching and scholarship.
Junior faculty are reviewed each year on research, teaching and service.
The post combines clinical work with teaching and research duties.
quiet: Hiring decisions weigh a candidate's experience, salary and references.
The company is known for excellence in design and engineering.
The agency did market research before launching the new cereal.
The award recognizes customer service at the hotel's front desk.
Her contract divides her time between London and Paris.
The police praised the public's help in the search for the child.
The car goes in for a service each year in March.
The detective did some research into the suspect's past.

notes: Card: ' research'/' scholarship'/' Teaching' as the second item of 'teaching and …' at a university. Probes: 'teaching, research and service' 2.23 of max (peak ' service'), 'scholarship and service' 1.12, 'teaching and research' 0.82, 'left teaching to pursue research' 0.32; 'market research' 0.02, 'search of the building' 0.02.
